title: Your MSFS 2024 add-ons are fighting for priority (here's why).
description:
Are your MSFS 2024 add-ons fighting for priority? In this video, we break down exactly why your custom airplanes, free sceneries, or background traffic utilities are breaking or causing infinite loading screens, and why your MSFS 2024 add-ons are fighting for priority inside the new simulator folder structure.

With the latest MSFS 2024 community folder split, Asobo quietly implemented a massive architectural shift behind the scenes. Right next door to your classic folder sits an identical-looking neighbor: the Community 2024 folder. If your third-party installers don't respect the hard-coded ranking rules of the MSFS 2024 virtual file system (VFS), your local files are literally going to war with each other. 

In this MSFS 2024 community folder guide, we open up the simulator's brain to reveal the strict 5-step execution sequence it runs every single time you press play—from checking your userconfig.opt configuration file to the alphabetical override trick (Z-to-A ranking) used by advanced freeware mods to force custom file layers.

We also put eight of the biggest third-party developers to a hands-on compatibility test. By manually cutting and pasting files into the new native structure, we expose exactly what breaks, who relies on complex SimLinks or Junction points, and whose automated background updates will completely fracture if you move them.
